decoder_prior.why: pi equal to the mean served gait_prob over all windows makes E[q/pi] = E[(1-q)/(1-pi)] = 1, so the gait channel adds no net pull on average; the labelled-window prevalence leaves out the unlabelled and masked windows the decoder also sees, and with it E[q/pi] = mean_q_over_previous_pi (> 1: a standing pull toward gait)
